# Steven Long Tran — Senior Product Designer

> 11 years making complex software feel intuitive. San Francisco ↔ Medellín. EN · VI · ES. This site is static HTML, fully readable without JavaScript; every case study leads with the outcome.

## Case studies
- [T-Mobile API Marketplace](https://steveux.com/case-studies/api-marketplace): designed for customers who might not be human; 10+ enterprise launch partners, 200 codebases on one platform
- [T-Mobile for Business Trade-in](https://steveux.com/case-studies/tmobile-trade-in): trade-in processing cut from 2–4 hours to 10–20 minutes per client; ~2k business clients a month
- [Western Union](https://steveux.com/case-studies/western-union): 72+ projects across 8 flows, 200+ countries, 40+ languages
- [Healthcare, rare disease (NDA)](https://steveux.com/case-studies/rare-disease): first responsive property for the client; two-year engagement extension earned
- [Koé](https://steveux.com/case-studies/koe-2026): betting platform redesign, 2015 work rebuilt for 2026 with a live prototype
- [FindMyBike](https://steveux.com/case-studies/findmybike-2026): theft recovery as an agentic workflow, 2015 work rebuilt for 2026
- [Compas](https://steveux.com/case-studies/compas): in progress; 3 method legs, zero invented claims enforced

## Method
- [How I work with AI](https://steveux.com/ai-operation): a personal AI OS running daily; this site had zero mockup phases
- [The rebuild log](https://steveux.com/rebuild-log): the site documenting its own 3-day rebuild
- [The explorations](https://steveux.com/): the same portfolio in 15 fully built alternate identities; 256 combinations from one engine
